# Focus: Tokenization in Generative AI
text = "A model predicts one next token."
tokens = text.lower().replace(".", "").split()
token_ids = {token: i for i, token in enumerate(sorted(set(tokens)))}
print({"tokens": tokens, "ids": [token_ids[t] for t in tokens]})
# This whitespace tokenizer is illustrative; production tokenizers use model-specific rules.
